verdict.rationale: Automatic failed-payment retries fit a subscription billing and management platform like RevenueCat, especially given its own RevenueCat Billing offering, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions payment retry logic, dunning cadence, grace periods, or involuntary-churn recovery. Webhooks, charts, and Web Billing support are adjacent features and do not show this capability.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn
